tasks.goal: Make authored change grammar durable under the configured spec root.
steps: Freeze one ID grammar and changes/<immutable-id> layout in the permanent contract; slug/title remain metadata.

tasks.title: Separate intent and work graph identities
tasks.goal: Implement meaningful-input hashing without making work into runtime state.
steps: Define work item IDs, predecessor edges, artifact needs and touches hints; validate a structural DAG.
Frame intent and work hashes separately with canonical ordering and recipe version.
Exclude observations/run logs/closure from their own subject; include selected work only in later execution request inputs.
positive_cases: Local normative edit changes intent; cosmetic slug edit does not.
Work reordering outside a selected contribution does not invalidate unrelated intent.
negative_cases: Cycle/duplicate work IDs and done/owner/current fields refuse.
Closing a change cannot change the intent snapshot it closes.

tasks.title: Integrate saved-state and overlay change analysis
tasks.goal: Reuse M-16 editing boundaries for a safe change reader and future writer.
steps: Connect change parsing to the accepted source/overlay snapshot interface.
Allow pure diagnostics over a client's dirty change documents without updating authored files or lock.
Prepare future authored changes only from saved captured state; revalidate buffer/disk epochs through the existing writer coordination contract.
positive_cases: Two clients analyze different dirty refinements without cross-client leakage.
negative_cases: Dirty or changed affected document produces save-required/stale before writes.
A saved buffer does not automatically authorize an older dirty-buffer plan.
